explanations.explanation: This feature fires on the terminal punctuation that closes off a self-contained, headline-style or first‐line statement—i.e. it’s effectively marking end-of-sentence (or end-of-heading) boundaries.
This feature lights up on the final punctuation of a post’s headline or question‐title—i.e. it marks the boundary at the end of the initial title line in Q&A/forum entries.
